## Sources

This is table clarify my conceptual map of the smolt and adult migration stages to justify matching the NCC and AK stages with specific other species.



```{r gt test}
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
library(stringr)
library(flextable)
library(ftExtra)

# 1. Define data frame with BibTeX keys
df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Stage,   ~Location, ~DistShore,   ~Length_mm, ~Citation,
  "Smolt",  "NCC" ,     "150-300",  "[@fisher_early_2014]",
  "Smolt",  "WCVI"  ,   "850",      "[@weitkamp_stock-specific_2015; @daly_ontogenetic_2009]",
  "Smolt",  "SEAK",     "3400",     "[@daly_implications_2024]"
)


#Example
# df <- tibble::tribble(
#   ~Stage,   ~Location,   ~Length_mm, ~Citation,
#   "Smolt",  "NCC" ,     "150-300",  "[@fisher_early_2014]",
#   "Smolt",  "WCVI"  ,   "850",      "[@weitkamp_stock-specific_2015; @daly_ontogenetic_2009]",
#   "Smolt",  "SEAK",     "3400",     "[@daly_implications_2024]"
# )

# 2. Extract citations automatically for Pandoc
table_citations <- df %>%
  pull(Citation) %>%
  str_extract_all("@[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique() %>%
  paste(collapse = "; ")

# 3. Render table
# df %>%
#   gt() %>%
#   fmt_markdown(columns = Citation) %>%
#   cols_label(
#     Stage = "Stage",
#     Location = "Location",
#     Length_mm = "Length (mm)",
#     Citation = "Referenced Sources"
#   ) %>%
#   tab_header(
#     title = md("**Salmon Stages and Associated Species**"),
#     subtitle = "Sources for salmon prey, alternate prey for predators, and salmon predators by region"
#   )

df %>%
  flextable() %>%
  colformat_md(j = "Citation") %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Stage = "Stage",
    Location = "Location",
    Length_mm = "Length (mm)",
    Citation = "Referenced Sources"
  ) %>%
  autofit()
```

[r table_citations]{style="display: none;"}
<!-- Hidden citations for Pandoc -->
<span style="display:none">`r table_citations`</span>

```{r example only}
library(dplyr)
library(gt)
library(stringr)
library(flextable)
library(ftExtra)

# 1. Define data frame with BibTeX keys
df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Stage,   ~Location, ~Length_mm, ~DistShore_nm,  ~Depth_m,  ~Season,  ~Citation,
  "Smolt",  "NCC" ,     "150-300",  "0-60nm",      "na",     "Spring-summer", "[@teel_genetic_2015;@weitkamp_stock-specific_2015;  @daly_spatial_2012;@daly_ontogenetic_2009]",
  "Smolt",  "WCVI"  ,   "150-300",  "0-60nm",      "122 m",   "Summer",       "[@tucker_life_7]",
  "Smolt",  "BC/SEAK",  "200-400",  "long 125-128","<100 m", "Summer-fall-winter", "[@tucker_life_7]",
  "Immature","BC/SEAK", "350-550",  "long 127-135","<100 m", "Summer-fall-winter", "[@tucker_life_7]"
)


# 2. Extract citations automatically for Pandoc
table_citations <- df %>%
  pull(Citation) %>%
  str_extract_all("@[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+") %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique() %>%
  paste(collapse = "; ")

# 3. Render table
df %>%
  flextable() %>%
  colformat_md(j = "Citation") %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Stage = "Stage",
    Location = "Location",
    Length_mm = "Length (mm)",
    DistShore_nm, "Distance from shore \n(nautical miles)",
    Depth_m = "Depth (m)",
    Season = "Season",
    Citation = "Referenced Sources"
  ) %>%
  autofit()
```
